comment: P33-H2 hero start-anchor vectors (findings_Player-33 §1, Fix A, Thomas 08.11). The START deploy of the initial heroes carries no window and (pre-fix) no ledger row - these cases pin the anchor channel that must light up in round 1: reader guards (junk payloads fail CLOSED in Core), the deploy-fakt rule label on anchor/explain/dump, ring+contest+threat fed by a start anchor with NO hero activation yet (round 1 the Imperials act first), the multi-field hypothesis set (no point claim), the retract on set growth, the fenster-fakt flip when a window fact overwrites the entry claim, and the freshness law (a stale start anchor is never reused as a position). expect blocks were recorded once via --record and reviewed; the expect_hand blocks are hand-pinned ground truth (the law IS the expectation). The HOTH12 case (p33_hoth12_four_starts) is the Player-33 reconstruction: 4 start heroes, one blue field section - the acceptance criterion of card t_db6814bb.

cases.name: p33_hoth12_four_starts
cases.comment: ACCEPTANCE (HOTH12-Konstellation): four start heroes enter through the single printed blue field of section sec-start (HOTH12: 'Entrance' - 'Deploy the heroes here.'). ALL FOUR get an anchor with round=1 and rule=deploy-fakt, and the ring/contest/threat channel lights up in round 1 BEFORE any hero has closed a turn - exactly what Player-33 missed the whole mission. No activation, no interact: the printed setup fact alone is the anchor.

explain_must: explain hero Jyn section=sec-start(Start Section) round=1 rule=deploy-fakt
explain hero Verena section=sec-start(Start Section) round=1 rule=deploy-fakt

cases.comment: READER GUARD: an empty hero designates nobody (no ghost '?', no anchor); a valid entry WITHOUT the section key is an honest presence fact - the hero enters the view but NO spatial claim is made. The boobytrap case 'GHOST' proves presence and position are separate channels: H|GHOST exists, hero GHOST and any explain/ring line do not.

cases.name: p33_stale_anchor_no_ring
cases.comment: Freshness law: the start anchor is a POSITION claim only while it is fresh (round-stamped at the reading round). Round 2 without any new hero fact reads ring - threat - : a stale deploy fact dilates the belief mask (its own law) but is never silently reused as where the hero stands. This is what keeps Fix A from freezing the whole empire on the entrance for the rest of the mission.
